reference.source: lengthM (118.5 m overall), beamM (10.8 m) and maxSpeedMps (35 kn, converted with 1 kn = 0.514444 m/s) from the English Wikipedia article 'Kagero-class destroyer', read 2026-09-26. Japanese Monograph 149, an official postwar translation, records the 15-ship Kagero-class construction program (primary class confirmation, checked 2026-09-26). deckHeightM and turnRateRadPerS (3 deg/s) are ESTIMATES. hullHp (Fletcher plus half a rocket) is a gameplay choice. ARMAMENT (Track M, M1, read 2026-10-08): Yukikaze in October 1944, as tools/models/blender/kagero-dd.py cites (combinedfleet.com TROM; English Wikipedia 'Japanese destroyer Yukikaze', whose August-September 1943 refit replaced the aft 5-inch turret with a pair of triple 25 mm): two twin 127 mm/50 (low-angle), two triple 25 mm at the X mount's site, two triple abreast the aft funnel and one twin before the bridge (drawn with the triple kit, two barrels). The class 'up to 28 x 25 mm by 1944' (same article) is not dated for Yukikaze, so the later singles stay omitted (DP2's ruling). Positions are that script's ESTIMATES.
